why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Check that your country isn't restricted (see below).
Open app.extended.exchange and connect an EVM or Starknet wallet, then sign the two messages that create and register the account.
Deposit USDC. EVM wallets can fund from Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Arc, Polygon, Avalanche or BNB Chain; Starknet wallets use Starknet only.
Trade, or put USDC into the vault. Your balance is on the points page .
costs: Takers pay 0.025% per trade and makers pay nothing; on RWA markets the taker fee is 0.010%. You also pay network gas on deposits and withdrawals. Vault deposits have a $5 minimum and a 24-hour lockup. The Trading Fees and Rebates page in the Extended docs on 18 October 2026, listing taker and maker fees. risks: Extended is closed to people in the US, the UK, Canada, Hong Kong, Russia, the Seychelles and several sanctioned countries and regions. Points can be cut or cancelled for wash trading, self-referrals, multiple accounts or bots. Extended can change, pause or end the program, and points have no guaranteed value.
